_comment: Verified source registry for Lake Mattoon watershed monitoring. Every entry here was tested by fetching it. 'access' records HOW it can be retrieved; 'blocked' entries are documented so we don't re-attempt them. New sources are proposed by scripts/lakewatch/discover.py and added here only after human review.

sources.name: City of Mattoon — Water Quality Update (cumulative log)
sources.notes: The most recent 'Water Quality Update' post is a cumulative archive of EVERY microcystin reading, not just the latest. One fetch gets the full time series (75 readings as of 2026-08-11). Find the newest post by matching the title text 'Water Quality Update' — date slugs are inconsistent (july21, august-25-2025, july-30-2026).

sources.name: City of Mattoon — Public Notices index
sources.notes: Also carries Wake Boat Committee notices, waterfowl hunting drawings, and one-off water reports. Plain HTML, no CAPTCHA.

sources.name: City of Mattoon — City Council meeting index
sources.notes: Meeting DATES and document TITLES are scrapable from /download/city-council-meeting-YYYY-MM-DD/ pages. The PDFs themselves are NOT — see 'blocked' below. Regular meetings are 1st and 3rd Tuesdays.

sources.name: Coles County SWCD — Lake Mattoon/Paradise Watershed Committee
sources.notes: Best-access source found. robots.txt allows /wp-json/ (only /wp-admin/ is disallowed), so the WP REST API is usable. Agendas are plain .docx under /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/, no CAPTCHA. Committee is open to anyone; mailing list at mattoonandparadisewatershed@gmail.com. WARNING: site is HTTP-only, no HTTPS — do not submit any form here.

sources.name: Coles County Board — agenda archive
sources.notes: PDFs are unlocked and directly fetchable. Filenames carry random suffixes (ARPA_Agenda_zolEFLm.pdf) so URLs must be scraped, not constructed. TLS chain is incomplete — some clients fail cert verification where curl succeeds.

sources.name: Coles County Board — minutes archive
sources.notes: Minutes are posted only after board approval, typically the month following the meeting.

sources.name: Shelby County Board — agendas and minutes
sources.notes: Most of Lake Mattoon's shoreline is in Shelby County. Found by the discovery job 2026-08-11 and verified: 200, robots allows. Gotchas: ~1000 links, relative hrefs, uppercase .PDF, and ordered oldest-first, so links must be resolved and ranked by year rather than taken in document order.

sources.name: Cumberland County Board — agendas and minutes
sources.notes: Cumberland County holds part of the lake and its watershed. Found by the discovery job 2026-08-11 and verified: 200, robots allows (only wp-admin paths disallowed).

sources.name: Illinois EPA — Harmful Algal Bloom program
sources.notes: Where a Lake Mattoon or Lake Paradise bloom would be officially recorded for the season. IEPA is the agency behind the microcystin numbers the City publishes.

sources.name: City of Mattoon — news feed
sources.notes: Where the Wake Boat Committee announcements landed.

sources.name: Water Quality Response and Recovery Report (Aug 2025)
sources.notes: 37-page reference doc. Establishes that Lake Paradise is the PRIMARY water source and Lake Mattoon is a CONTINGENCY source. 'Lessons Learned' and 'Next Steps' sections were published blank pending a debrief — watch for a revised version.

sources.name: Illinois EPA — Lake Mattoon & Lake Paradise TMDL report
sources.notes: Standing regulatory reference (simazine TMDL). Not a recurring feed.

blocked.name: City of Mattoon — council agendas, packets, minutes (PDFs)
blocked.detail: WP Download Manager 7.5.3 marks these 'wpdm-download-locked'. Direct fetch returns 'You are not allowed to download.' The unlock flow (/?__wpdmlo=<pkg>&__wpdmfl=<file>) serves a page reading 'Verify CAPTCHA to Download'. Verified blocked via plain curl, curl with cookie jar + referer + browser UA, and same-origin fetch() from a real browser session. DO NOT attempt to bypass — this is the city's explicit signal against automated retrieval, and defeating bot detection is off-limits for this project regardless of how public the records are.
workarounds: Manual drop: a person downloads the PDF and saves it to data/minutes/ named with the meeting date. brief.py reads it from there. This is the only path by which agenda CONTENTS reach the brief. See data/minutes/README.md.

Records request to the City Clerk (Susan J. O'Brien, 217-235-5655, City Hall 2nd floor, 208 N 19th St). Verified 2026-08-11: the Clerk's office issues certified copies of Council minutes, ordinances, and resolutions. Illinois FOIA does not require using an agency's own form — a plain written request suffices, which matters here because the City's own FOIA request form sits behind the same CAPTCHA as the records.

Illinois OMA 5 ILCS 120/2.06 requires approved minutes to be posted to the website within 10 days of approval and to stay up at least 60 days. Asking to be added to a distribution list is a reasonable request to make of the Clerk.

blocked.name: City of Mattoon — WordPress REST API
blocked.detail: The API is live and would be the ideal ingestion path, but mattoon.illinois.gov/robots.txt contains 'Disallow: /wp-json/'. Off-limits. Use the sanctioned HTML pages instead. Note the sitemap index only covers posts and pages (46 posts) — downloads are not listed.

blocked.name: facebook.com/mattoonIL
blocked.detail: Facebook's robots.txt blocks automated fetching. Treat as a human-checks-periodically source, or use the Meta Graph API with a proper app. Note: mattoon.illinois.gov embeds a Facebook feed plugin, so some FB content may render server-side on the city site.
